note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit moved to core rfc8956_fragment_test.go. It changed only by the family identifiers and the now-exported NewFlowFragmentMatchComponent. RFC 8956 Section 3.6: "The Type 12 component bitmask MUST be encoded as a single octet bitmask (bitmask_op len=00)." A value of ^uint64(0) through the IPv6 FlowSpec and IPv6 VPN producers must encode exactly {12, 0x81, 0x0e} (len=00, one octet) via WriteTo and Bytes(), so core writeToAFI applies fragmentMask before choosing the width. The negative requires ParseFlowSpec/ParseFlowSpecVPN to refuse a 0x91 (len=01) two-octet operand.
